preserved_scientific_settings: Every original binding, rule, finite boundary, 64-run schedule, deterministic seed, frozen weight, search budget, native gate, original heap and cost ceiling unchanged. Only the shorthand API token is normalized.
continuation_protocol: Unchanged v1 admits all rules and guards, then preserves its API failure after the first three unaffected short-boundary trials. V2 pins exact v1 native/progress/audit bytes, resumes the remaining 61 runs, and retains all three original trial trees. A complete independently replayed native prefix may be reused only by exact receipt binding. Full model/tree audits are fresh for all 64 trials.
cost_accounting: Original failed-worker cost remains in v1 elapsed wall time. V2 preparation/search/native costs are added. Independent native replay reuses only an exactly pinned complete v1 audit and charges its full recorded costs, plus every fresh whole-certificate replay. Continuation waiting time is recorded separately.
